items.source_en:
Contributing Researchers: Dr. Juli Aigner, Dr. William Clarke, Kallyn Thibodeau

After conducting three weeks of intensive research on this planet's surface, our team has concluded that this location IS suitable for long-term human habitation. This planet boasts an abundance of peaceful creatures that would be suitable for use as a food source, and mineral-rich topsoil perfect for growing crops. 

Our team spent considerable time trekking around the area near our landing site in order to locate suitable places for future settlements. We've left behind several markers for future teams. Each warrants further investigation by the Empire as a potential building site. 



PROPERTY OF THE GALACTIC EMPIRE. DATA NOT INTENDED FOR PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION.

우리 팀은 향후 정착에 적합한 장소를 찾기 위해 착륙 지점 주변을 샅샅이 뒤졌습니다. 차후 방문할 팀을 위해 여러 표식을 남겨두었으며, 각 장소는 제국 차원에서 건설 부지로 추가 조사할 가치가 충분합니다.
